message: You know me—I like to be gloriously over-prepared for anything that might come my way. I recently came across a fantastic resource about handling power outages, and it's packed with practical tips to keep your family safe and comfortable when the lights go out. From food storage to lighting options, it’s all about staying calm and ready. So, if you want to feel like a preparedness pro, check it out and maybe even share a tip or two with your neighbors!
